description: This file defines the TermStorageInterface interface for taxonomy term storage classes in Drupal, specifying methods for retrieving parent, ancestor, child terms, and other taxonomy-related operations.

classes.name: TermStorageInterface
classes.description: Interface for taxonomy term storage classes, extending ContentEntityStorageInterface with methods for loading parent, child, and other taxonomy terms.

methods.name: loadParents
methods.description: Finds all parent terms of a given term ID.

methods.name: loadAllParents
methods.description: Finds all ancestor terms of a given term ID.

methods.name: loadChildren
methods.description: Finds all child terms of a given term ID, optionally restricted by vocabulary ID.

methods.name: loadTree
methods.description: Retrieves a tree of terms within a vocabulary, with options for depth and entity loading.

methods.name: nodeCount
methods.description: Counts the number of nodes in a vocabulary.

methods.name: resetWeights
methods.description: Resets weights for terms in a vocabulary.

methods.name: getNodeTerms
methods.description: Retrieves terms used to tag specific nodes, optionally filtered by vocabulary and language.

methods.name: getVocabularyHierarchyType
methods.description: Returns the hierarchy type for a vocabulary.

methods.name: getTermIdsWithPendingRevisions
methods.description: Lists term IDs with pending revisions.
